label: Heavy fuel oil combustion
definition: Particulate V and Ni from heavy oil burning in power generation shipping or industry not attributed to a sector by the source
citation: Hamdan 2021 10.3389/fenvs.2021.666678 (V 60 ng/m3 Ni 40 ng/m3 heavy oil markers) and Anwar 2024 10.1016/j.envadv.2024.100573 (heavy oil combustion PMF factor)

label: Road CO and benzene emissions
definition: Tailpipe carbon monoxide and benzene from road vehicles
citation: Teixido 2021 10.1007/s11869-021-01000-2 (CO down 25.8 % and benzene down 19.9 % in lockdown, both considerably influenced by road transport)

label: Ambient VOC and OH reactivity
definition: Concentration of reactive hydrocarbons and total OH sink in ambient air
citation: Pfannerstill 2019 10.5194/acp-19-11501-2019 (OH reactivity up to 32.8 s-1 over the Arabian Gulf) and Bourtsoukidis 2019 10.5194/acp-2019-92 (166.5 ppb alkanes)

label: Road dust resuspension
definition: Resuspended road surface dust driven by traffic wind and humidity
citation: Matthaios 2022 10.1016/j.scitotenv.2022.155368 (29.6 % of coarse roadway PM) and Chen 2023 10.1016/j.envpol.2023.122283 (23 to 33 % of near-road PM2.5)
